xna-type.name: GamerServicesComponent
xna-type.summary: Wraps the functionality of the GamerServicesDispatcher.
xna-type.remarks: If a game will use gamer services, a GamerServicesComponent should be added to the game's Components collection. GamerServicesComponent will take care of initializing and updating the GamerServicesDispatcher at the appropriate times.

parameters.parameter: The game that will be associated with this component.

exceptions.exception: If the current game uses the XNA Framework Redistributable. This file does not include Games for Windows – LIVE functionality. If another Games for Windows – LIVE title is running already.
The gamer services functionality is already initialized.

constructor.remarks: Important Games for Windows - LIVE is not available to finished games. This functionality is not included in the redistributable version of the XNA Framework, and a game that attempts to use these components without XNA Game Studio installed will result in a GamerServicesNotAvailableException .
